co_omniglobal.name: OmniGlobal Dynamics
co_omniglobal.dana_line: Sorry. Reorg. As of two minutes ago I'm Partner III. Continue.
co_omniglobal.art: glass atrium, badge gates, LED wall where the stock ticker goes up and a small HEADCOUNT counter goes down, ping-pong table "RESERVED FOR Q3 OFFSITE".

co_nimbus.name: Murkcloud
co_nimbus.card_joke: Cloud and AI. Mostly AI. Humans sometimes.
co_nimbus.insider: Your cloud runs half of Byteburg.
co_nimbus.dana_line: Our AI screened you first. It rated you 6/10. It rates everything 6/10.
co_nimbus.review: 3/5 - Interviewed, onboarded and laid off by the AI.
red_flags: First interview is with an AI
co_nimbus.art: server racks fading into parallax fog, cold blue light, floor decal "AI-FIRST. HUMANS-SOMETIMES.", an Employee of the Month frame showing a server.

co_adverse.name: Engagement Farms Inc.
co_adverse.card_joke: Parent company of ClikClok. Yes, that ClikClok.
co_adverse.insider: You own ClikClok. I'm on it daily.
co_adverse.dana_line: Every time someone here says 'family', a desk disappears. Watch.
co_adverse.review: 4/5 - Great free food. Ate it alone after the restructure.
co_adverse.art: candy-colored open office, neon "WE'RE A FAMILY" sign, nap pod "BOOKED UNTIL 2027", engagement graphs on every wall.

co_beigeware.name: Beigeware Financial
co_beigeware.dana_line: Days since last incident: 0. Days since last reorg: 2,000. We like it that way.
co_beigeware.review: 4/5 - Nothing exciting ever happens. I'm so happy.
co_beigeware.art: beige cubicles, one flickering light, a fax machine taped "DO NOT UNPLUG - PROD", a sad ficus, a sign "DAYS SINCE LAST INCIDENT: 0".

co_bytebistro.name: Lukewarm Express
co_bytebistro.card_joke: Food delivery. The fries are in the lake again.
co_bytebistro.insider: You deliver a million meals a week.
co_bytebistro.dana_line: Sorry, that alert was the fries. They're on the highway. Again.
co_bytebistro.review: 3/5 - Free lunch every day. It arrives at 4 PM.
co_bytebistro.art: converted warehouse, wall-sized live map of delivery scooters (some in the lake), neon burger sign, a "SURGE PRICING" gong.

co_pixelpivot.name: Scope & Creep Digital
co_pixelpivot.card_joke: An agency. Your next client is a mattress store.
co_pixelpivot.insider: You shipped 14 client apps last year.
co_pixelpivot.dana_line: This interview is billed to a regional mattress chain. Please be concise.
co_pixelpivot.review: 3/5 - Built 14 apps in a year. I dream in invoices.
co_pixelpivot.art: exposed-brick loft, a wall of parody client logos (mattress store, dentist, lettuce startup), a Gantt chart ending in a hand-drawn skull.

co_synergai.name: Hierarchai
co_synergai.card_joke: An AI agent that manages your AI agents.
co_synergai.dana_line: Quick update: we're AI for pets now. Same questions though.
co_synergai.art: co-working warehouse, neon "HUSTLE" sign, beanbags, kombucha tap, a hockey-stick graph with no axes.

co_quantumleaf.name: Entangled Greens
co_quantumleaf.card_joke: Blockchain, quantum, and lettuce. Mostly lettuce.
co_quantumleaf.insider: You grow lettuce with sensors. Neat.
co_quantumleaf.dana_line: Part of your salary is LettuceCoin. Its value is: lettuce.
co_quantumleaf.review: 4/5 - Great culture. Paid partly in lettuce.
co_quantumleaf.art: greenhouse office, hydroponic lettuce under purple grow-lights, a padlocked box labelled "QUANTUM" with one blinking LED.

co_stealth.name: Stealth Mode Inc.
co_stealth.dana_line: Please sign this NDA about the NDA. Great. Hello.
red_flags: You can't know what you're applying for
co_stealth.hired_extra: You may now know what we do. ...It's a to-do app.
co_stealth.art: basement, blacked-out windows, a whiteboard under a bedsheet, one humming server rack, a shredder with a "BUSY" light.
